name: de.aufblatt/aufblatt
title: Aufblatt
description: PDF accessibility check, 48-hour flipbook demo from a PDF URL, prices and provider comparison.

tools.name: pdf_check
tools.description: Checks a PDF from a public https URL for technical accessibility prerequisites, like the PDF check at https://demo.aufblatt.de/pdf-check: document title, language, tags, text on all pages, headings and their order, alternative text of figures, link names. Returns a status per item (ok, missing, partial, na), findings by severity with recommendations, and the number of pages. Nothing is stored; the PDF is deleted right after the check. Limits: at most 150 MB and 500 pages, a few checks per day per address. This is not a legal conformity assessment (for example BFSG, BITV or WCAG). Deutsch: prüft eine PDF per Adresse auf technische Voraussetzungen der Barrierefreiheit und speichert nichts.

pdf_url.description: Public https URL of the PDF (standard port 443, no login). Deutsch: öffentliche https-Adresse der PDF.

tools.name: create_demo_flipbook
tools.description: Downloads a PDF from a public https URL and turns it into a browsable flipbook demo on https://demo.aufblatt.de, like https://demo.aufblatt.de/demo. The demo is public to anyone with its link, not indexed by search engines, and deleted after 48 hours. Stored until deletion: only the PDF and the catalogue made from it; no IP address, no email address. Limits: at most 150 MB and 500 pages, a few demos per day per address. Requires confirm_publication=true (the user may publish the file and it contains nothing confidential). Returns a demo_id and the first state; get_demo_status with this demo_id shows progress and, when ready, the catalogue URL. Deutsch: macht aus einer PDF-Adresse einen Blätterkatalog als Demo, der nach 48 Stunden gelöscht wird.

pdf_url.description: Public https URL of the PDF (standard port 443, no login). Deutsch: öffentliche https-Adresse der PDF.

confirm_publication.description: Must be true. By setting it, the user confirms: "I am allowed to publish this file. It contains nothing confidential." Stored are only the PDF and the catalogue made from it, until deletion after 48 hours. No IP address, no email address. Deutsch: „Ich darf diese Datei veröffentlichen. Sie enthält nichts Vertrauliches.“

language.description: Language of the flipbook interface (default de). Deutsch: Sprache der Oberfläche.

tools.name: get_demo_status
tools.description: Returns the state of a demo created with create_demo_flipbook: queued (with the number of demos ahead), running (with progress 0 to 1), ready (with the catalogue URL and deletion time) or failed (with the reason). Unknown and expired demo_ids give the same answer. Deutsch: Stand der Aufbereitung, danach die Adresse des Katalogs.

tools.name: calculate_price
tools.description: Calculates the yearly price of Aufblatt for a number of published issues (catalogues, magazines, manuals), with line items, setup fee, first-year total and tax note, from the same data as https://aufblatt.de/preise/. Deutsch: Jahrespreis für n Ausgaben wie auf der Preisseite.

issues.description: Number of published issues per year, 1 to 1000. Deutsch: Zahl der Ausgaben.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Returns researched facts about other flipbook and ePaper providers from the comparison at https://aufblatt.de/vergleich/, each fact with its source URL on the provider’s own site and the retrieval date. Without providers: all providers with an overview (pricing model, hosting location, export, after cancellation, custom domain). With providers: all facts and plans of those providers. Valid ids: 1000grad, yumpu, issuu, flipsnack, flippingbook, publuu, paperturn, blaetterkatalog, blaetterwerk, flipaio. With issues: the cheapest plan per provider for that many issues per year, next to the Aufblatt price. Deutsch: Angaben aus dem Anbietervergleich mit Quelle und Abrufdatum je Angabe.

providers.description: Provider ids to include. Valid: 1000grad, yumpu, issuu, flipsnack, flippingbook, publuu, paperturn, blaetterkatalog, blaetterwerk, flipaio.

features.description: Only these fact keys, for example hosting_ort, eigene_domain, selbstbetrieb_export, api.

issues.description: Number of issues per year for the annual cost comparison.
